title: Longest Word in Dictionary through Deleting Letters
goal: Solve Longest Word in Dictionary through Deleting Letters: Find the longest word in dictionary that can be formed by deleting letters from string.
strategy: Find the longest word in dictionary that can be formed by deleting letters from string.
edgeCases: Candidates must be subsequences, not substrings; equal maximum lengths use the stated lexicographic tie-break.
inputRules: dictionary must be an array of strings, e.g. ["ale","apple"]
